answer: Standing decays by path length, so an idle identity loses weight in proportion to how far its attestations travelled. Step one: each epoch the node stores the shortest independent path from the identity to a seed auditor. Step two: an account silent for one epoch drops one level on that path, and a long vine that only vouches inward collapses as one unit. Take an account at weight 40 that idles 12 epochs at 2 per epoch: it lands at 24, while a neighbour still auditing outside its own karst keeps 37. A knoll of 500 idle accounts ends up worth one live agent, and rebuilding takes 12 weeks.
